name: final_sudoku_benchmark_hint
description: A benchmark measuring an AI model's ability to solve Sudoku puzzles given partial hints; it evaluates logical reasoning, constraint satisfaction, and stepwise inference needed to complete grids. Tasks require producing the completed grid or the next-step moves in a structured textual format. Performance is assessed by exact correspondence between the model's completed grid and the ground-truth solution.
reputation: A niche dataset used for puzzle-solving and reasoning evaluations with modest adoption in the research community.
